It is a good grill for a relatively good price. Some of the great features include:
1. Gas Gauge
2. Ease of Lighting
3. Size - In our tight space, we're able to open the lid easily and the side drops, which is convenient. Relative to the size of the overall grill, the grilling surface is quite large.
4. Reversible Grill Grates for different types of food

Main Drawback:

For a mid-range/higher-priced grill there are still a number of cool spots on the grill that cause uneven cooking and browning.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is just right. Regarding performance, this grill has very good range, control, and evenness of temperature. The range is as good as any grill I've owned. The control of the temperature is the best of any grill I've owned. And the evenness of the temperature across the cooking surface is the best of any grill I've used. Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought my grill from Home Depot and was crushed upon opening it to find, without any evidence of damage to the shipping box, to find massive damage to the grill inside including a broken off chunk of the lid, damage to the lower half of the upper grill and a shattered grate. Weber moved into action as soon as I tweeted about the terrible find and within just a couple of days had replaced without any grief whatsoever, the grill bottom, the lid and the grates, essentially like 70% of the grill. All free, all wjth FedEx shipping and even more protected than previously. There were extra instructions to move a few pieces over to these new replacement grill lid and burner box parts and the process took no more time that really it would have been to build it in the first place. The build was easy and sensible, the design made it impossible to build things accidentally in the wrong way. The grill just feels better made than any I’ve had before. As to using it, it’s awesome. The igniter works perfectly, the flames are even and steady and there aren’t any real hot or cool zones within the grate, if the burners are all on, it’s an even cooling space heat wise. After about 8 meals on the grill in the first couple of weeks, it’s an A+. The service and support I’ve already received give me great confidence about the future with this grill.
Results.Title: Bad arrival rescued with great service

Results.ReviewText: I love the way this grill lights up immediately. Turn on the gas turn the first burner push button and it's lit no hesitation at all. Plenty of room to cook all your favorite foods. Very attractive makes a nice addition on my deck.
Results.Title: Quick ignition!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I purchased my new grill from a local hardware store that had free set up and local delivery. Have had the grill now for 4-5 weeks and love it. So nice to have a grill that I can regulate the temp. so easily. I am looking forward to getting the rotisserie and learning how to use it.
Results.Title: Owner

Results.ReviewText: Bought to replace old grill, very happy with decision .
Results.Title: sturdiness

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Grill is terrific. Typical Weber quality. And, it heats up faster than previous Webers that I have owned. 

On the other hand, the fold down shelf works well as a shelf, but horribly as as a handle to move the grill. Just the slightest bump, or crossing a joint in the pavement and the shelf lets go from it’s “locked” position. Total bummer as there is no way to lock the shelf in place to percent this from happening. Fixing this would get me to rate it five stars.
Results.Title: Great grill. Folding shelf, not so much.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This new Weber grill is an amazing upgrade to my last Weber I had for 16 years. I am now doing rotisserie once a week, from chicken, lamb, pork, so juicing and delicious. I love having 3 burners so I can do a lot of indirect heat.
Results.Title: BEST GRILL EVER!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Photos.Caption: Heavy Duty Retractable Workbench Casters added to my New Spirit Grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill replaced a ten-year old Spirit model.  It is better in every way - sturdier, more even heating, better grilling bars, more precise controls, etc.  This new one, however comes with only two wheels (bigger and better than before).  I use a walker and had trouble moving the new grill so I drilled holes in the two front legs and bolted on Heavy Duty Retractable Workbench Casters.  Now, the new grill moves easily.
Results.Title: Better than Before

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber grill and my favorite feature is the ability to accurately set the temperature. It is a very sturdy and well made product.

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
